title: Niin's Forever World Therapy
description:
Don't have the discipline to stop creating new worlds?
This lightweight, client-side and fully configurable mod is for you.
body:
![Forever World Therapy](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/719dcd9ad5e618695e1a0b165b436fe30e4ac5a1.png)
## Do you want to have a real forever world but lack the discipline to stop yourself from hitting that sweet sweet "Create New World" button over and over again?
Search no further, with Forever World Therapy, you can limit the amount of worlds you're allowed to create to one (or more, it's easily configurable and compatible with [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)!)

You can even make that pesky button disappear once you reach the limit if you want to really forget about it!

![The select world menu showcasing the "Create New World" being disabled.](https://i.imgur.com/pwE4N5d.png)
